title: Random pushes escape in bf16 too
note_on_values: Every number below was read back from the artifact's own output files (escape_by_engine.json and pn.json), not copied from the draft caption. All four numerics are re-runs of the SAME 40 fixed random directions / per-sample plan-noise pushes from one shared bf16 snapshot of Qwen3-8B: a=W8A8 (native 8-bit float weights+activations), b=W8A16 (8-bit float weights, bf16 activations), c=W16A8 (bf16 weights, 8-bit float activations), d=bf16 (full precision).

panel_a.title: Escape fraction of 40 fixed random directions, α = 2
panel_a.what: Share of 40 fixed random directions pushed into the task-spec activations at alpha=2 that flip the written algorithm, each engine scored against its own twin (confirmed/n_run out of 40), with Wilson 95% intervals. Source: escape_by_engine.json -> [engine][task]['alpha']['2.0'].

W8A16.note: confirmation stage incomplete; value is the screen-level pass rate n_screen_pass/n_run, drawn hatched with no error bar

panel_b.title: Per-sample plan noise, α = 2
panel_b.ylabel: share of 50 valid attempts on an alternative algorithm
panel_b.what: Share of 50 fresh per-sample isotropic noise pushes (alpha=2) that land on a catalogue algorithm other than the twin's default, out of 50 valid attempts. Source: pn.json -> [task]['PN_a2'][engine].

control_marker.label: iteration 5: bf16, ban-free unit, other seeds (1/50)
control_marker.source: a different iteration-5 experiment's bf16 plan-noise run on the same task, using its own ('ban-free') noise unit and direction seeds at a smaller effective dose; cited in this artifact's results/relabel_table.json as 'iteration-5 bf16 PN null on T10 (1/50 at its ban-free unit, block-12 dose 0.66x this unit)', class 'DOSE (not reproduced at the absolute unit)' -- i.e. the near-zero result traces to the different unit/seed convention, not to bf16 itself.

takeaway: In both panels the bf16 bars sit close to the W8A8 bars, and the W16A8 bars are not higher than the bf16 bars, so 8-bit float activation rounding alone does not create the escapes.
